definition.name: Managed Task queue native and individual Timer capacity

steps.name: Fetch the immutable native producer source before authentication
Check exact managed capacity and timer producer boundaries
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_managed_capacity tools.tests.test_dotnet_managed_timers -v

steps.name: Execute actual CLR Task state controls with explicit test ports
Execute actual timer ownership CLR state controls with explicit test ports
Check actual deferred timer source after its creating task returns
Install the normal captured compiler isolation boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Prepare the pinned compiler and current closed-runtime adapters
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/capacity-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/capacity-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/capacity-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/capacity-tools" \
  --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"

steps.name: Check the actual private timer driver against the original two queued slots
Authenticate the exact five historical products and all 134 native materials
Compile one capacity component and execute seventeen strict owner cases
Retain bounded public capacity source build and actual owner evidence
